question: How many repetitions are prescribed in the sacred field of Viraja, O auspicious one?
premises: The sacred field of Viraja is specified.
The practice is said to be likewise.
Twelve hundred thousand repetitions are stated.
inference: In the field of Viraja, twelve hundred thousand repetitions are required.
plain_english: Likewise, O auspicious one, in the field of Viraja it is by twelve hundred thousand.
